checkpoints.description: [1/2] Audio cycle: weapon-switch click/caption, failing-first tests, slot-2 pair and switch drill

impact_assessment.why: The sim emitted switch:<weapon> but the game ignored it, so slot changes were silent.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each slot gets a distinct click and a caption naming the gun.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cue/clip tests, slot-2 pair, 30-frame switch drill with same hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Switch cue proven: 136 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 7828 px pair, audio 0->3/cue PULSE, same hash f03a087f; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-29-switch-cue' completed successfully.
[1/2] Progression cycle: record campaign wins in run history, failing-first tests, W/L debrief pair and 3000-frame run

impact_assessment.why: Campaign clears only incremented wins; last_run/history were written by death alone, so wins vanished from the record.
impact_assessment.benefits: Wins now appear in last_run/history and the debrief marks W/L.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: profile state only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: schema-3 history (outcome already present).
impact_assessment.mitigation: Clear/death/duplicate tests, seeded debrief pair, 3000-frame campaign run with same hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Win history proven: 140 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 656 px W/L debrief pair, kite 3000 wins=1/runs=1/history win, same hash 945e3fdd; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-30-win-history' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat cycle: kill-only crosshair marker, failing-first tests, first-kill pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: A kill used the same crosshair hitmark as a body hit; no aim-point confirmation distinguished the final hit.
impact_assessment.benefits: The kill is readable at the crosshair in addition to sound, feed, particles and hitstop.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: presentation timer only, not in snapshot; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: juice killmark_s.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Kill/non-lethal/expiry/draw tests, first-kill pair, same kite hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Kill marker proven: 144 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 100 px four-tick pair, same kite hash 4fe640c5; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-31-killmark' completed successfully.
[1/2] Enemies cycle: warden slam-radius ground ring, failing-first tests, windup pair and same-hash slam run

impact_assessment.why: The 4.5 m slam radius was invisible during the windup, so the player could not tell if they were inside.
impact_assessment.benefits: A dashed ground ring shows the exact slam danger zone before it lands.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: presentation nodes only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: juice slam_ring DATA.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ring radius/visibility/DATA tests, staged windup pair, same slam hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Slam ring proven: 148 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 3560 px ring pair, same slam hash 4580b9da; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-32-slam-ring' completed successfully.
[1/2] Levels cycle: off-screen surge-pickup edge tag, failing-first tests, facing-away pair and same-hash pickup run

impact_assessment.why: The pickup label named the reward but gave no direction when the beacon was behind the player.
impact_assessment.benefits: A green SURGE chip at the bearing points to the reward when off-screen.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Off-screen/ahead/inactive tests, facing-away pair, same pickup hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Pickup arrow proven: 151 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 1768 px edge chip, same pickup hash 7f84f3e9; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-33-pickup-arrow' completed successfully.
[1/2] UI cycle: width-following death debrief, failing-first fit tests, six-digit pair and same-hash death run

impact_assessment.why: Six-digit W/L history overflowed the fixed 380 px debrief panel.
impact_assessment.benefits: The panel follows its longest line; normal scores keep the 380 px layout.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: draw-only; dependency: keystone.ui.font text_width (already used); concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Wide-fit and normal-width tests, six-digit pair, same death hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Debrief width proven: 153 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 15022 px panel pair, same death hash f8cd9e28; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-34-debrief-width' completed successfully.
[1/2] Graphics cycle: 8 wall pilasters, failing-first tests, spawn-view pair and same-hash run; budget reduced from 16 after the 45-call plan failure

impact_assessment.why: The four boundary walls were flat gray planes with no vertical rhythm.
impact_assessment.benefits: Shared-material pilasters add wall depth while staying under the 40-draw plan.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: decoration nodes only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; budget: 16 nodes failed the plan, 8 pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pilaster count/position/material tests, frame-budget gate, spawn pair, same kite hash.
